scientific_integrity: The explicit discrete Green function is credited to prior effective-resistance work; new claim is the exact absolute transfer-current projection norm, edge-type crossover, limiting transition and noncommuting singular limits. Exact computational tests corroborate the all-parameter analytic proof but do not constitute an infinite certificate.
scientific_limitations: Real finite wheel graphs, unit rim conductances and a single common positive spoke conductance; symmetric square-root-conductance edge-coordinate normalization, not unscaled currents. The grounded Green kernel was previously known. All-parameter novelty and historical priority warrant independent review.
title: Exact endpoint amplification and spoke–rim transition in weighted wheel networks
